verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a public API: an API reference overview, API key generation with role-scoped global keys, incident creation via the API from external automation, and a public status-page JSON API. The official MCP server, which exposes incident data and actions to agents, adds to this programmatic surface. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at the standard paths), evidence of API coverage beyond incidents and status pages (e.g., on-call, workflows, retrospectives), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
